Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4808149. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay_chembl_id CHEMBL4808149, require standard_value not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno and join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to enforce structure presence. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
